abstract:
pdb_cpp is an open-source C ++ library with Python bindings that unifies coordinate parsing, atom selection, hydrogen-bond detection, solvent-accessible surface area calculation, and DockQ and TM-score/US-align based structural comparison on one shared coordinate representation, enabling fast end-to-end evaluation of docked and AlphaFold-predicted complexes without repeated format conversion.
pdb_cpp is implemented in C ++ with Python bindings, distributed under the GPL-2.0-or-later license, and available from PyPI and GitHub at https://github.com/samuelmurail/pdb_cpp. Documentation is available at https://pdb-cpp.readthedocs.io.
Supplementary figures and benchmark results for peak memory usage, DockQ, TM-score, and SASA are available online at Bioinformatics.\.
